home.headline: From terminal to App Store.
home.subheadline: I build mobile apps people actually keep on their phone.
home.mynu.problem: Generic diet apps ignore real body composition and have food databases that are slow or expensive to query.
home.mynu.build: Python backend orchestrating AI agents with LangGraph, semantic (RAG) search over the food database for faster, cheaper lookups, a React Native app, and native Swift/Kotlin modules via Nitro Modules for notification scheduling.
home.mynu.impact: Solo-built, from the AI backend to the app, live on the App Store.
home.pomodoo.problem: Pomodoro timers for Mac often come bloated, require an account, or pile on features that get in the way of focus.
home.pomodoo.build: Native Swift and SwiftUI app, no external dependencies — customizable work/break intervals, notifications and color themes.
home.pomodoo.impact: Solo-built, live on the Mac App Store.
home.ploomes.problem: A mobile CRM for complex sales needs native-grade reliability: proprietary security integrations, real-time engagement and a modern architecture without losing performance.
home.ploomes.build: React Native with native Swift and Kotlin modules, proprietary and third-party security SDKs integrated at the native layer, Live Activities for real-time visit check-in, contributions to React Native's New Architecture (Turbo Modules) and bundle modularization, Fastlane + GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines, and on-device AI with offline fallback.
home.ploomes.impact: Cut app startup time by refactoring the initialization layer; data-driven decisions via Firebase Analytics and Crashlytics; live on the App Store and Google Play.
home.playfast.problem: Booking with different companies means calls, messages and waiting — with no single place to get it all done.
home.playfast.build: React Native app, contributing features as part of a team — multi-company scheduling, PIX payments, Google/Apple sign-in, and family/dependent account management.
home.playfast.impact: 10K+ downloads on Google Play, live on both stores.
